mechanism.claim: In an elevated-variation BTC auction, a completed direction repeatedly carried more strongly by spot than perpetual price displacement across most nonoverlapping half-hour intervals represents cash-sponsored price discovery rather than leverage-led marking; follow the common completed direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour spot and perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSDD counts interval-level same-direction cash displacement dominance using returns only. Cash-participation migration uses quote-turnover shares; spot-flow leadership uses aggressor flow; first-passage leadership uses barrier timing; basis/error-correction uses price-level spread; variance transfer discards direction. HVSDD uses no volume, flow, basis, fitted outcome, OI, funding, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: current perpetual variation must occupy its causal upper thirty-five percent and cash must dominate at least two-thirds of half-hour directional intervals
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset cross-market interval-dominance clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.paths: 96 exact completed aligned spot and perpetual five-minute closes over [D-8h,D)
features.half_hour_returns: sixteen nonoverlapping log(last close/first open) returns per venue from exact six-bar groups
features.cash_dominant_interval: spot and perpetual half-hour returns share one strict sign and abs(spot return)>abs(perpetual return)
features.aggregate_confirmation: completed eight-hour spot and perpetual returns share one strict nonzero sign
features.perpetual_variation: sqrt(sum squared 95 five-minute close-to-close perpetual returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier jointly source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligibility: dominance and aggregate confirmation and variation gate

clock.feature_available: offset eight-hour boundary after both paths complete
clock.entry: exact perpetual BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed sixteen-interval cash displacement dominance and high-variation confirmation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no interval, dominance, confirmation, variation rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
